string-array.name: riddle_text
string-array.item: I am the beginning of eternity, the end of time and space, the beginning of every end, and the end of every place. What am I?
I have layer upon layer. If you take them off, you will cry, even though I won\'t hurt you. What am I?
I fly without wings, I whistle without a mouth, I strike without hands, and you cannot touch me. What am I?
I have a face and hands, but no arms or legs. What am I?
It always goes up and never comes down. It is the one thing we all share without trying. What is it?
Round, round, a barrel without a bottom. What is it?
I have a head and a tail that never meet. Having too many of me is always a treat. What am I?
I follow you everywhere, copy your movements, but if there is no light, I die. What am I?
I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
I am so fragile that if you say my name, you break me. What am I?
The more I dry, the wetter I get. What am I?
I have teeth but cannot bite. I detangle but I don\'t exist without hair. What am I?
Yellow on the outside, white on the inside. If you step on my peel, you might slide. What am I?
I have leaves but I am not a tree. I have a spine but I am not an animal. I tell you stories without speaking. What am I?
It belongs to you, but others use it more than you do. What is it?
I am born in the mountains, I die in the sea, and I never stop walking. What am I?
I have a neck but no head, I have a body but no arms. What am I?
Two sisters, it is no lie, one is my aunt, the other is not. Who is she?
What is something that, the bigger it is, the less you see?
It goes in hard and big, and comes out soft and small. What is it?
I am in the water and do not get wet, I am in the fire and do not burn. What am I?
I have keys but no locks, I have space but no rooms. What am I?
Which weighs more, a pound of lead or a pound of feathers?
Taken from a mine and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released, and yet I am used by almost everyone. What am I?
I have long ears, a short tail, I run and jump very lightly. What am I?
I have only one color, but I can have many sizes. I stick to the sun, but I disappear with the rain. What am I?
I grow without being alive, I breathe without lungs, and I consume without a mouth. What am I?
I come out every morning and hide in the afternoon. I give light and heat, and I am round. What am I?
I am always in front of you, but you cannot see me. What am I?
Five brothers very united who cannot look at each other. What are they?
I have eyes but cannot see, I have a crown but I am not a king, I have scales but I am not a fish. What am I?
I am tall when I am young, and I am short when I am old. I light up your life and cry wax. What am I?
You see me in the water, but if you try to catch me, I disappear. What am I?
I pass through water without getting wet, I pass through fire without getting burned. What am I?
What has legs but cannot walk, has wings but cannot fly, has eyes but cannot see?
The more you wash it, the dirtier it looks. What is it?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?
If you have me, you want to share me; if you share me, you haven\'t got me. What am I?
What has four legs in the morning, two at noon, and three in the evening?
You can see me once in a minute, twice in a moment, and never in a thousand years. What am I?
I am pretty in front and somewhat ugly in back. I transform every instant as I imitate others. What am I?
What runs but has no feet, and murmurs but has no mouth?
If you feed me I live, if you give me a drink I die. What am I?
What goes up and down but never moves?
I am full of holes, yet I hold water. What am I?
I have an iron head and a wooden body. If I hit your finger, you scream in pain. What am I?
Who goes from bed to bed but never sleeps, and sometimes pokes you?
I am not a bird, but I can fly. I carry people in my belly. What am I?
Only once a year do you celebrate me, with cake and candles, and the number grows at last. What is it?
I have fingers but no flesh, bone, or blood. What am I?
I tear when I fall on the ground, but I bounce on the water. What am I not?
What has a heart that doesn\'t beat, leaves that don\'t fall, and a spine that doesn\'t hurt?
I fly at night, sleep by day, and you will never see feathers on my wing. What am I?
It has been in the sea for years and still doesn\'t know how to swim. What is it?
I travel all over the world but I always stay in the corner. What am I?
I have roots that nobody sees, I am taller than a tree, and I never move. What am I?
A small box, white as lime, that everyone knows how to open and no one knows how to close. What is it?
Which word contains 26 letters but has only three syllables?
It goes in dry and arrogant, comes out wet and dripping. What is it?
Falls from the tower and doesn\'t die, falls in the water and dissolves. What is it?

string-array.name: lateral_text
string-array.item: A man walks into a bar and asks for a glass of water. The bartender pulls out a fake gun and points it at him; the man says "thank you" and leaves. What was wrong?
"I have no brothers or sisters, but that man\'s father is my father\'s son." Who is the speaker looking at in the portrait?
A man pushes his car to a hotel and upon arriving realizes he is bankrupt. What happened?
Two fathers and two sons go fishing. They catch three fish and there is one whole fish for each. How is this possible?
A farmer had 15 sheep and all but 9 ran away. How many does he have left?
There are three switches outside and three light bulbs inside a closed room. You can only enter once. How do you know which is which?
A boy has an accident; the surgeon says "I cannot operate on him: he is my son", but the surgeon is not the father. Who is it?
In a race, you overtake the person in second place. What place are you in?
A man lives on the 10th floor. He takes the elevator down, but when going up, if he is alone, he goes to the 7th and walks the rest. If it rains or he is not alone, he goes to the 10th. Why?
A man leaves his house (which has 4 walls facing south), sees a bear. What color is the bear?
Some months have 31 days, others have 30. How many have 28 days?
A man drives a black truck, with the lights off and no moon. A lady crosses the street and he brakes just in time. How did he see her?
A woman has two children who were born at the same hour, on the same day of the same year, but they are not twins. How is this possible?
How can you throw a raw egg against a concrete floor and not crack it?
A man is born in 1995 and dies in 1950. How is this possible?
There are 6 eggs in a basket. 6 people take one egg each. How is there still one egg left in the basket?
A bus driver goes down a one-way street in the opposite direction and passes a police officer. The officer does not ticket him. Why?
What animal walks with its legs on its head?
A dog is tied by the neck to a 2-meter rope. However, it manages to reach a bone that is 4 meters away. How?
You have two jugs: one of 3 liters and one of 5 liters. How do you measure exactly 4 liters with unlimited water?
How long would it take to cut a wooden log into 10 pieces if it takes 1 minute per cut?
You are running a race and you overtake the last person. What position are you in?

A farmer must cross a river with a fox, a chicken, and corn. He can only carry one. If he leaves the fox with the chicken, it eats it. If he leaves the chicken with corn, it eats it. How does he cross?
Anthony and Cleopatra are found dead on the floor of a villa in Egypt. Nearby there is broken glass and water. They have no wounds. Who are they?
A man looks at a portrait and says: "Brothers and sisters I have none, but that man\'s father is my father\'s son". Who is in the portrait?
There is a cat in a tunnel. The train is coming and the cat has no escape, but it does not die. Why?
A digital clock reads 12:00 and does not advance, it is not the battery nor is it broken. What is happening?
With 6 matches, form 4 equilateral triangles without breaking them.
In the middle of a snowy field appear a carrot, a pile of coal, and an old scarf. No one put them there recently. What happened?
A man enters a room full of gas, with a lit match, and there is no explosion. Why?
